snippet.title: Short Short Fictions - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Coming out in 2026
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3617080/_/

If you could get any wish granted at the very end of your life... What wish would you choose?

"Short Short Fictions"
A short short mix tape of one story that connects three shorter stories. On the NewWave, a magical game console that is retro but new, enjoy DON'T SAY YES, TO:NORTH, and a secret tale nobody yet knows. Welcome to a slightly fantastical and nostalgic world of painful, toilful, and beautiful stories!
